page.overview:
Who is Division 4 Male Member?

Division 4 Male Member was an unnamed character from the Chainsaw Man manga and anime series. He was a member of Tokyo Special Division 4 and was partnered with Fushi.

He has short black hair, black eyes and protruding cheekbones. He is often seen wearing a serious expression on his face.

He is shown to have a mature and caring personality during the "newbie welcome party". He is also shown to tell Denji to eat more because he's young during the party.

At some point he was drunkenly kissed by Himeno.
